_note: What a new player is told (game/welcome_panel.gd, game/first_tips.gd). welcome: the 'how a round works' screen shown before the traditions pick of every run (Yusuf, 2026-10-24): title, intro, steps (when, name, text), rounds_line, earth_line, ages_line and closing (Yusuf's line: try things, a fallen village is another story lost to time; the loss screen shows lost_line). tips: one-time tips, each shown once the first time its moment comes (FirstTips.due says when), in this order when several are due; at says where it sits: hand (above the building hand), threat (beside the attack card), top (under the top bar, over a pick) or map (over the middle of the map).

welcome.title: You rule. You don't command.
welcome.intro: Your heroes and townsfolk think for themselves. You shape the town around them, then watch what they make of it. Each round goes like this:

steps.name: Build
steps.text: Draft one blueprint to keep for the whole run, then build what you can afford. Homes and food are always on offer. Buildings find their own spot.

steps.name: Pick a newcomer
steps.text: Choose one card: a tribesperson, a family, a hero. Your buildings decide who turns up. Everyone you take eats.

steps.name: Watch
steps.text: Townsfolk gather and craft, heroes hunt in the wilds. The third night brings the attack the card on the right warns of. Hold, and you pick a relic.

welcome.rounds_line: Survive %d rounds. Raise the next age when you're ready: it costs a lot, and pays back.
welcome.earth_line: Between rounds the earth clicks round, and the attack crosses different ground. Feed it stone to turn it further.
welcome.ages_line: Neolithic, then Bronze, then Medieval, at your pace
welcome.closing: Try things. If the village falls, it is one more human story lost to time.
welcome.lost_line: One more human story lost to time. Try something different next run.

first_build.title: First build
first_build.text: Draft one blueprint to keep, then build. Homes and food are always here. Press Begin round when you're done.

first_attack.title: The attack
first_attack.text: This card shows what comes on the third night and which way it marches. Point at it for more.

first_dawn.title: First dawn
first_dawn.text: Pick one newcomer. Everyone eats, so keep an eye on food in the top bar.

first_hero.title: A hero
first_hero.text: Heroes cost shells and choose their own fights, gear and beds. You can only tempt them.

first_night.title: First night
first_night.text: Space pauses. Point at anyone to see what they're up to.

first_relic.title: First relic
first_relic.text: Relics last the whole run. Look for ones that suit your town.

first_earth.title: The earth turned
first_earth.text: The rings clicked round a plate. The attack card says which ground the attack crosses now; Feed the earth in the hand turns it one more.

first_age.title: A new age
first_age.text: Raising an age costs a lot, but opens a new ring of plots and new buildings.
